faq: Choose Personal Store to sell your own products with a cart and direct payment choices. Choose Affiliate Deals Shop to curate Amazon, AliExpress, Etsy and partner deals that open external merchant checkout. The catalogs stay separate. Amazon-related Affiliate items have disclosure, image and price safeguards with representative photo matching where needed.
Can I import products and create media without paid APIs?

Yes. Use the Chrome Extension or supported URL importer, then edit images locally in /tools: crop, resize, convert WebP/PNG/JPG, polish and add text. Capture local video covers and download storefront QR codes. The core tools use no paid media API. Optional configured stock-photo providers and embedded demos have their own access and privacy rules.
How do the seven payment methods work?

Personal sellers can enable Bank Transfer (RIB / IBAN / SWIFT), a hosted Card Checkout Link (CMI, Payzone, YouCan Pay, Stripe, Gumroad or Creem), PayPal, Payoneer, Wise, USDC and Cash on Delivery. Availability depends on the seller’s setup. Card details are entered only on the external provider’s website; SellPostly never asks for a card number, CVV or expiry date.
When does USDC escrow protection apply?

Only USDC payments can enter escrow. If the seller makes it optional, the buyer activates the checkout toggle; otherwise the USDC payment is direct. Required governance applies only to USDC. Bank, card links, PayPal, Payoneer, Wise and COD always remain direct. Funding must be verified before held status and release follows the applicable hold rules. SellPostly is SaaS software; independent sellers do not represent its brand.
Which tools are free, and what needs Pro?

The post formatter and browser media tools are free to use. Publishing storefronts and using the seller dashboard require an active SellPostly Pro license; check the shop activation screen for current plans. External payment providers or networks may charge their own fees. You can share store links in TikTok and Instagram bios, Pinterest pins, Facebook groups, YouTube descriptions, WhatsApp, blogs or search listings.
features: Two storefronts, two clear buying paths

Personal Store gives your own products a catalog, product pages, cart and direct ordering. Affiliate Deals Shop curates Amazon, AliExpress, Etsy and brand-partner links. Amazon-related Affiliate items have disclosure, image and static-price safeguards with automatic unbranded photo matching when needed; other merchant images and Personal Store photos stay unchanged.

Personal sellers can enable Bank Transfer (RIB / IBAN / SWIFT), a hosted Card Checkout Link (CMI, Payzone, YouCan Pay, Stripe, Gumroad or Creem), PayPal, Payoneer, Wise, USDC and Cash on Delivery. Availability depends on the seller’s setup. Card details are entered only on the external provider’s website; SellPostly never asks for a card number, CVV or expiry date.

Sellers choose off, optional for buyer or required for USDC. With optional governance, Enable Escrow Protection (USDC) starts unchecked: direct USDC goes to the seller, while opting in uses the configured Polygon escrow wallet. The funding workflow is pending_funding → held → released after Admin verification and the applicable hold rules. Every non-USDC payment remains direct, even when USDC escrow is required.
A creator media studio in your browser

Open /tools to crop and resize product photos, convert WebP, PNG or JPG, adjust photo polish and add badge or watermark text. Capture a cover frame from a local MP4/WebM and download a storefront QR code. Processing stays on your device. Send a finished image to My Shop through local storage without a huge image URL.

Import title, price, description and image through the Chrome Extension or a supported product URL, then review the result. Format seller or creator posts, keep affiliate tags where relevant, and share your store anywhere instead of depending on a single social channel.
Product demos that buyers can open

Add an optional YouTube, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Vimeo or direct MP4 demo link to a product. Watch Demo opens a responsive player with an original-page fallback. External media loads after the buyer chooses Play. Amazon listing videos are never scraped or imported.
